name: Download New Code at Runtime
summary: Adversaries may download and execute dynamic code not included in the original application package after installation. This technique is primarily used to evade static analysis checks and pre-publication scans in official app stores. In some cases, more advanced dynamic or behavioral analysis techniques could detect this behavior. strategies.name: Detection of Download New Code at Runtime

analytics.name: Analytic 1677
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Download New Code at Runtime by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed.
